text:
Maya: Quick kickoff — we need to lock the launch acceptance signals for console observability v1: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and basic error analytics. Customer asks from ACME + BetaCorp included.
Jun: Can we slim scope for the initial ship? dashboard templates + trace ingest hooks + lightweight cost view. error analytics can be follow-up.
Priya: we can't omit basic SLO/alerting entirely — customers expect an error-rate widget + at least one alert policy. recommend inclusion.
Alex: I can author the sample dashboard queries and cost calc. need the trace hook spec (which span attrs we surface).
Maya: Customer asks summary: ACME wants trace links to logs and per-request cost estimate. BetaCorp wants per-model token delta in cost UI. both want 1-click drilldowns.
Jun: technical note: trace hook minimal schema = {request_id, model_name, route_name, sample_rate}. we can implement headers and a small SDK shim. sample header: ```X-Req-ID: <uuid>
X-Model: <name>```
Priya: Alerting proposal: surface a throttled page when error spike >5% sustained for 5m, and a lower-priority Slack notify for 2-5%. include a short oncall playbook.
Maya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- 3 dashboard templates (routes, cost, errors) with sample data
- Trace ingestion hooks instrumented for node + python in the console SDK
- Cost breakdown widget showing per-route and per-model token cost with example queries
- Error analytics: error-rate cardinality + root-cause link to traces/logs
- Docs + acceptance tests (incl. canary rollout)
- Customer signoff from ACME or BetaCorp or two smaller pilots
Jun: can we make node/python only? that keeps dev time realistic. also need to confirm retention/sampling defaults. 2-week effort estimate if we focus on those items. :thumbsup:
Alex: I'll produce example SQL/Prom queries and a small CSV export for the cost calc. will also include perf notes for big orgs.
Priya: docs note — we must call out trace sampling rate and KV-cache masking (do not record sensitive prefixes). add short checklist for compliance review.
Maya: Recap action items: Jun = implement hooks (node + python) + canary rollout plan; Alex = dashboard queries + cost calc and examples; Priya = SLOs, alerts, oncall playbook; Maya = write launch checklist, docs, drive customer signoff. Target end-of-sprint milestone: 2024-04-05.
Jun: noted and starting a PR draft today. cc @Jun @Alex @Priya
Alex: will sync on queries tomorrow morning.
Priya: adding alert runbooks to the shared folder.
Maya: thanks team — will update the roadmap doc and ping stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
